findings.detail: TRA source building 8007498440 is detailed on desktop and mobile; LEN source building 535505340 becomes detailed after completion of child loading.
Original user camera has all foreground detail after settling; no visible building holes in reviewed frames. Water shoreline and ripples are continuous in the reviewed visible bank.
Actual enclosed courtyard 27724113 has restrained metric paving on both viewport sizes.

MET buildings 6939524390 and 6939524400 are initially detailed but are native in the later settled series with denied=1 and only 11.13 MB desktop or 1.37 MB mobile geometry. Both remain in the verified source snapshot. Cell z15-x21973-y10323, near-3-2-ca729ba1f7e2472b.glb.
Broad areas of pale untextured ground and weak building contact/directional shadows keep KAL, SOV, LEN and residential scenes diagram-like.
Long MET metal roofs retain conspicuous repeated diagonal motifs when their detailed material is visible; old broad contrast was reduced, not fully solved.
Repeated facade window arrangements, very regular roof equipment and simple tree crowns remain visibly procedural.
A CEN foreground tree visually appears near a road edge. A source-coordinate intersection has not been established and is not claimed.

limitations: Local Chromium SwiftShader with background development activity; no FPS or hardware-performance claim.
Initial 20 frames used an early readiness signal. Ten windows include loading frames and two final snapshots still had pending GLB work. Those frames are labelled transitional.

The 11-frame supplement awaited no GLB work, but user-mobile and waterfront-desktop had subsequent source/surface invalidations (7 and 5 frames over 2.2 seconds); final pause acceptance requires a separate settled scheduler check.
Each series has unchanged source hashes internally. laneTraffic.ts changed between the two series; visual catalogue is identical.
No screenshot proves continuous zoom, cache eviction, WebGL recovery, picking or bridge traversal. The waterfront camera does not frame the complete bridge.
Seven districts are sampled at actual source-building poses; this is not exhaustive whole-city visual validation.
PNGs are local QA artifacts; the repository retains portable names and hashes.
